[h1]Burgerboss Challenge!
[/h1] 

Forget the romance and heartbreak, we’re springing forward early! The Throwdown home screen will soon have a fresh, spring-time feel and a Burgerboss Fry Challenge.
 
The event will begin on Tuesday, February 12th and end on Tuesday, February 19th at 18:00 GMT.
 
[h1]What are Burgerboss Challenges?[/h1]

A Burgerboss Challenge is a special event that combines aspects of Swole Club with non-refill Challenges and adds a splash of something different, all wrapped together in a retro package.

Burgerboss Challenges have a unique Battleground Effect and are not affected by the Global BGE. Beginning at level 11, all enemy cards will get a 20% boost to Health, Attack, and all Skills. The boss will also gain a 20% boost to Health. These boosts increase by an additional 20% for every level after 11.

All players will begin at level 1 and must defeat Burgerboss Fry to get to the next level. Each level increases in difficulty and awards more points. Winning will move you up in difficulty and give you the points for the level you just won. Losing a battle will yield only 10% of the points for that level, so be wary of when levels start to get tough! If needed, use the arrow buttons to go up or down in difficulty.

This event is meant to be quite competitive: there are only 1,000 ranked rewards. However, there are milestones! Anyone that is able to reach a milestone requirement will get the rewards for it.

notes.title: SFC Updates, Hero Token Changes, and more
notes.content:
[h1]Secret Fight Club (SFC) Updates[/h1]

[list]
[*] Score cap will be expanded from 2500 to 3500
[*] Starting at 2500, the SFC Battleground Effect (BGE) will give the enemy deck a bonus percentage based on the player’s score (not the opponent’s score).
[*] A trophy as well as the rank and score of top SFC players will be displayed in Arena, Guild Rumbles, and other areas of the game.
[/list]

This change is expected to go live on November 28, 2018. We will continue to monitor Arena and player feedback for further improvements if needed.

[h1]Hero Token Changes[/h1]

We have updated the way Hero Tokens refresh in Arena. You are now able to “lock in” the Hero Token so that it will not change after a battle is completed. This means that once you find the hero you want tokens for, you can keep grinding for those specific tokens only. You will still get a new opponent after each battle.

The selection is automatic: simply do not refresh your opponent to keep the Hero Token drop the same. The selection should be saved even if you close the game and continue playing later. Of course, you have the option to refresh your opponent and token, if desired. Opponent and Hero Tokens are still linked: if you refresh one it will refresh the other.

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

We have been investigating a recent 51 guild member issue and have implemented a fix. This should hopefully prevent further issues in upcoming events; but we will continue to monitor, investigate, and fix as needed.

We are also aware that our recent update has caused some ranking boards to display incorrectly. It should now be fixed, but you may need to restart your game to see the changes.

notes.title: SFC Updates, Reward Updates, Daily Rewards, Bonus Weekend, and more!
notes.content:
Good afternoon and happy hump day! Here are some upcoming updates!

***

[h1] Reward Updates [/h1] 
We have readded the Legendary Stones to Brawls and Challenges - you may need to restart your app to view them.

https://animationthrowdown.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/115000724492

[h1] SFC Updates [/h1] 
We will be making some additional updates to SFC soon. This update will include a reset to the SFC leaderboard and the reset will come alongside a tiered reward for your final rankings. The reward tiers will be announced about a week ahead of the reset. Additionally, we may expand the viewable leaderboard rankings at the top of SFC, but this will require some server load testing - it won't be expanded if it adversely affects the player experience. A cap will also be implemented to help reign in excessive scores. A reset may cause some interesting matchmaking so be prepared for some very difficult or very easy fights for a week or two after the reset.

We will not be banning any accounts as we do not believe this strategy is a bannable offense. We are also working to hide player hand & deck info from data scraping. This update will release alongside the new client update.

[h1] Coin Bonus Weekend [/h1] 
This weekend we will be having a Coin Bonus Weekend! Specific time/dates will be posted in an upcoming changelog.

[h1] Daily Rewards [/h1] 
We are currently developing a new, additional Daily Rewards system. New daily rewards will be included in a 28-day calendar that starts at the 1st of each month. Players will have the entire month to log in and get rewards (if you log in 10 days out of the month you’ll get the first 10 rewards). We also include an additional 7 day calendar. This is a consecutive log in calendar so to get all 7 days of rewards you need to log in 7 days in a row (resets after missing a day or finishing the calendar).

[h1] Skill Bug Fixes [/h1] 

This upcoming client release (requires an App Store update) will include fixes for several reported Skill Bugs. Please check the upcoming changelogs for more details and as always you can contact our support team for any technical issues.

https://animationthrowdown.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/requests/new

[h1] WebGL Errors [/h1] 

Our team has received several reports of ongoing or increasing errors on the Kongregate.com version of Throwdown. Our team is working to resolve the issue and we thank you for your patience.

***

Thank you for the continued feedback and check back for more details!

- ShinyMetalMod



You can view this post on our forums and comment @ 

http://www.kongregate.com/forums/727066-general/topics/862056-official-sfc-updates-reward-updates-daily-rewards-bonus-weekend-and-more
